name: Fujisato (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Fujisato town emblem in white: a disc bearing a stylised bird-like arrow.
history: Municipal flag of Fujisato, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1963.

features.role: Fujisato town emblem — a disc bearing a stylised bird-like arrow
